findings.message: 1 frame reaches back further for main data than the decoder buffer of ISO/IEC 11172-3 and 13818-3 allows, which holds one frame at the highest bitrate: the first at 0x2A68 has a main_data_begin of 509 bytes where at most 0 are allowed. LAME has not enforced this limit by default since 3.81, and decoders accept it.
